data.one_liner: High-performance camera plugin built on the Nitro FFI bridge with zero method-channel overhead.
data.what_it_does: Provides photo and video capture, code scanning, frame processing, and GPU filters. Built on the Nitro FFI bridge for zero method-channel overhead.
use_when: You need high-performance camera capture and live frame processing without method-channel overhead.
You require built-in barcode and QR code scanning with background isolate decoding.
You want vision-camera-style declarative and imperative camera controls in Flutter.
avoid_when: Your target platforms do not include Android or iOS.
You only need to pick existing photos and videos from the device gallery rather than capturing live.
strengths: Zero method-channel overhead using the Nitro FFI bridge.
Zero-copy frame hand-off and background isolate processing.
Comprehensive feature set including photo/video capture, live filters, and code scanning.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific setup including iOS usage descriptions in Info.plist.
Early version release (0.0.3) which may still have evolving APIs.
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS 13.0+ with camera, microphone, and photo library usage descriptions in Info.plist. Android permissions are merged automatically but require runtime requests.

alternatives.name: camera
